name: ducttapegames-site
description: Duct Tape Games website, deployed to Cloudflare Pages

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p 'dist/DTG Assets' 'dist/.well-known' 'dist/html' && cp -R index.html app-ads.txt _headers _redirects robots.txt 4a9f2977851e259ad282de1b1950e1b2.txt css JS games webgl dist/ && cp html/404.html dist/404.html && cp -R .well-known/assetlinks.json dist/.well-known/ && cp -R 'DTG Assets/app_icon' 'DTG Assets/screenshots' 'DTG Assets/steam_capsules' 'dist/DTG Assets/' && node build/generate-static-pages.js && cp html/auth-callback.html html/link.html html/profile.html dist/html/ && node build/generate-sitemap.js
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=$npm_package_config_pagesProject --branch=preview
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=$npm_package_config_pagesProject --branch=main
